body.text: Why are Yeşilköy and Florya ideal bases for Istanbul Expo Center (IFM) visitors?

Staying in Yeşilköy, Florya, or Ataköy cuts out the 45-to-75-minute cross-city commute that catches many trade-fair delegates who book hotels in Taksim or Sultanahmet. Because the [Istanbul Expo Center (IFM)](https://mariushotel.com/events/istanbul-jewelry-show-2026.html) sits directly in Yeşilköy next to the DTM–İstanbul Fuar Merkezi M1A metro station, nearby coastal hotels turn exhibition mornings into short, predictable rides.

Major international trade shows—such as the Istanbul Jewelry Show and the World Halal Summit—draw tens of thousands of buyers into Bakırköy, straining taxi availability along the E-5 highway at 09:00 and 18:00. Basing yourself in Yeşilköy or neighbouring Ataköy lets you reach IFM halls in 5 to 10 minutes by car or one short transit hop, then unwind along flat, tree-lined seafront paths instead of sitting in evening gridlock. Ataköy Marina adds international full-service hotels and quiet waterfront cafes suited for client debriefs.
What is worth seeing at Atatürk Marine Mansion and Florya coastal parks?

Florya's shoreline pairs 1930s Republican modernist heritage with wide public parkland overlooking the Sea of Marmara. The centerpiece is the Florya Atatürk Marine Mansion—designed by architect Seyfi Arkan in 1935 on pilings over the water—surrounded by the Florya Coastal Park, Atatürk Forest, and a flat cycling promenade connecting toward Yeşilköy.

Administered by the Presidency of National Palaces ([Milli Saraylar](https://www.millisaraylar.gov.tr/Kurumsal/Hakkimizda)), the Florya Atatürk Marine Mansion sits roughly 500 metres from Florya Marmaray station. Because restoration schedules can affect interior access in 2026 (the pavilion has recently shown temporary closure notices), verify current opening status on the Milli Saraylar portal before making a dedicated trip. Even when interiors are closed for conservation, the coastal park walkways, seafront tea gardens, and the adjacent Florya Social Facilities promenade remain open daily for relaxed morning walks and sunset views across the Marmara.
How fast is Marmaray from Yeşilköy to Sultanahmet (20 min)?

The Marmaray suburban rail line runs directly from Yeşilköy station to Sirkeci station—at the edge of Sultanahmet—in roughly 20 to 22 minutes, bypassing surface traffic completely. Trains operate every 8 to 15 minutes throughout the day using a standard İstanbulkart or contactless bank card.

From Sirkeci, Topkapı Palace, Hagia Sophia, and the Grand Bazaar lie within a 10-to-15-minute walk or two stops on the T1 tram. Staying one stop further west at Florya adds only 3 minutes to the rail ride, while Ataköy station trims it to about 17 minutes.

Confirm exhibition-hall entry gates: IFM spans 11 halls; check your hall number so your driver drops you at the nearest gate.
Plan Sultanahmet sightseeing after 17:00: Take Marmaray from Yeşilköy to Sirkeci in 20 minutes for an evening walk or dinner without road traffic.
Verify Florya Mansion hours before walking over: Check [Milli Saraylar](https://www.millisaraylar.gov.tr/Kurumsal/Hakkimizda) updates in case conservation work restricts interior entry.
Book Yeşilköy seafood tables by early afternoon: Local regulars fill prime fish restaurants on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights.

body.text: Where are the best seafood restaurants in Yeşilköy?

Yeşilköy is one of Istanbul's strongest dining neighbourhoods for seasonal Marmara and Aegean fish, led by [Eleos Yeşilköy](https://www.eleosrestaurant.com/yesilkoy/), a white-walled meyhane recognized by the [MICHELIN Guide](https://guide.michelin.com/en/istanbul-province/istanbul/restaurant/eleos-yesilkoy). Nearby streets around Yeşilbahçe Sokak and the marina also host long-standing neighbourhood fish houses serving cold meze, grilled calamari, and line-caught seasonal fish.

Eleos Yeşilköy blends Greek, Armenian, and Aegean coastal recipes—standouts include stuffed anchovies (hamsi dolma), grilled octopus, seafood börek, and olive-oil greens—in a calm garden and indoor hall a few blocks from the shore. Unlike tourist-heavy fish alleys around Kumkapı, Yeşilköy restaurants serve predominantly local families and business hosts, keeping pricing transparent and fish turnover brisk. Always confirm market price per kilogram before ordering whole seasonal turbot (kalkan), sea bass (levrek), or bluefish (lüfer).

faq.q: How far is Yeşilköy from Istanbul Airport (IST)?
faq.a: By car or private transfer via the Kuzey Marmara and Basin Ekspres corridors, Yeşilköy is typically 40 to 55 minutes from Istanbul Airport (IST), depending on weekday rush-hour traffic.

faq.q: Can I walk from Yeşilköy hotels to the Istanbul Expo Center (IFM)?
faq.a: While the straight-line distance is only 2 to 3 kilometres, highway interchanges make walking impractical. A 5-to-10-minute taxi or one stop via Yenibosna/Ataköy onto the M1A metro is far safer and faster.

faq.q: Is Yeşilköy safe for solo business travellers walking in the evening?
faq.a: Yes. Yeşilköy and Florya are quiet, well-lit residential coastal districts where local families stroll along the seafront promenade well into the evening.

faq.q: Does Marmaray run straight from Yeşilköy to the Asian side of Istanbul?
faq.a: Yes. The same Marmaray train continues under the Bosphorus from Sirkeci to Üsküdar and Ayrılık Çeşmesi (Kadıköy connection) in roughly 30 to 35 minutes without changing lines.

faq.q: What is the best season to enjoy Florya's coastal parks?
faq.a: April through June and September through November bring mild 18–26°C temperatures, sea breezes, and clear Marmara views ideal for morning runs or walks.

faq.q: Are there English-speaking menus at Yeşilköy seafood restaurants?
faq.a: Established venues like Eleos Yeşilköy and Ataköy Marina restaurants provide English menus and staff accustomed to international trade-fair guests.
